```{r}
#| label: build-shot-simulator-payload
#| results: asis

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(arrow)
  library(dplyr)
  library(jsonlite)
})

data_dir <- "data"
if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) dir.create(data_dir, recursive = TRUE)

sched_cache <- file.path(data_dir, "shot_sim_schedule.rds")
shots_cache <- file.path(data_dir, "shot_sim_shotmaps.rds")

master_schedule_url <- "https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/ibk1u01s67trk4htmhav6/master_schedule.parquet?rlkey=k943rqlck6qaomy5qovf4q98p&dl=1"
shotmaps_url        <- "https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/78zxfgwywkge3umf86rj2/historical_shotmaps.parquet?rlkey=l8601gfmi6vgldzc8y7twgtb0&dl=1"

master_schedule <- tryCatch({
  df <- arrow::read_parquet(master_schedule_url) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(date = as.character(as.Date(date))) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(date), match_id)
  saveRDS(df, sched_cache, compress = "xz")
  df
}, error = function(e) {
  if (file.exists(sched_cache)) readRDS(sched_cache) else stop("Schedule data unavailable.")
})

shotmaps_raw <- tryCatch({
  df <- arrow::read_parquet(shotmaps_url)
  saveRDS(df, shots_cache, compress = "xz")
  df
}, error = function(e) {
  if (file.exists(shots_cache)) readRDS(shots_cache) else stop("Shotmap data unavailable.")
})

shots_grouped <- shotmaps_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    match_id = as.character(match_id),
    xg_clamped = round(pmin(as.numeric(xg), 0.999), 4)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(match_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    venue = dplyr::first(na.omit(as.character(venue))),
    h_xg  = list(xg_clamped[is_home == TRUE]),
    a_xg  = list(xg_clamped[is_home == FALSE]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

shots_lookup <- setNames(
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(shots_grouped)), function(i) {
    list(
      venue = ifelse(is.na(shots_grouped$venue[i]) || !nzchar(shots_grouped$venue[i]), "League Match", shots_grouped$venue[i]),
      h_xg  = shots_grouped$h_xg[[i]],
      a_xg  = shots_grouped$a_xg[[i]]
    )
  }),
  shots_grouped$match_id
)

schedule_payload <- master_schedule %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    match_id    = as.character(match_id),
    date        = as.character(date),
    competition = as.character(competition),
    home        = as.character(home),
    away        = as.character(away),
    home_score  = as.numeric(home_score),
    away_score  = as.numeric(away_score)
  )

nwsl_colors <- dplyr::tibble(
  team_name = c("Angel City FC", "Chicago Stars", "Houston Dash", "Kansas City Current",
                "Gotham FC", "North Carolina Courage", "Seattle Reign FC", "Orlando Pride",
                "Portland Thorns", "Racing Louisville", "San Diego Wave FC", "Utah Royals",
                "Washington Spirit", "Bay FC", "Boston Legacy FC", "Denver Summit FC"),
  team_color = c("#F1B1A5", "#3AB5E8", "#FF6900", "#62CBC9",
                 "#A9F1FD", "#B4A269", "#5D7BA8", "#61259E",
                 "#99242B", "#C5B5F2", "#FC1896", "#FDB71A",
                 "#EDE939", "#DFDEDE", "#36E882", "#20604E")
)

usls_colors <- dplyr::tibble(
  team_name = c("Brooklyn FC", "Carolina Ascent FC", "Dallas Trinity FC", "DC Power FC",
                "Fort Lauderdale United FC", "Lexington SC", "Spokane Zephyr FC", "Tampa Bay Sun FC",
                "Sporting JAX"),
  team_color = c("#C5BFAE", "#BD7DB6", "#54052B", "#177BD9", "#A7E6D7", "#00EA1F", "#0095B3", "#FBDF49", "#00ADEE")
)

england_colors <- dplyr::tibble(
  team_name = c("Arsenal", "Aston Villa", "Brighton", "Chelsea", "Everton", "Leicester City", "Liverpool",
                "London City Lionesses", "Manchester City", "Manchester United", "Tottenham Hotspur",
                "West Ham United", "Birmingham City", "Blackburn Rovers", "Bristol City", "Charlton",
                "Durham Women FC", "Newcastle United", "Portsmouth", "Sheffield United", "Southampton FC",
                "Sunderland", "Crystal Palace", "Ipswich Town WFC", "Nottingham Forest WFC"),
  team_color = c("#EF0107", "#95BFE5", "#0057B8", "#034694", "#003399", "#003090",
                 "#C8102E", "#00E5FF", "#6CABDD", "#DA291C", "#FFFFFF", "#7A263A",
                 "#0000FF", "#009EE0", "#A71930", "#E90013", "#004B87", "#000000", 
                 "#000080", "#E30613", "#D71920", "#F51026", "#1B458F", "#000033", "#DD0000")
)

france_colors <- dplyr::tibble(
  team_name = c("Saint-Etienne", "Dijon Foot", "Fleury Merogis U.S", "Nantes", "Le Havre", "Marseille",
                "Montpellier", "OL Lyonnes", "Paris FC", "Paris Saint Germain", "Lens", "Strasbourg", 
                "Toulouse", "Saint Malo"),
  team_color = c("#006F3C", "#E30613", "#E21017", "#FFE300", "#002D5E", "#00A2E2", "#0B1D33",
                 "#DA0019", "#0F1626", "#004170", "#E30613", "#005CA9", "#51267D", "#004B87")
)

australia_colors <- dplyr::tibble(
  team_name = c("Adelaide United", "Brisbane Roar FC", "Canberra United FC", "Central Coast Mariners", 
                "Melbourne City FC", "Melbourne Victory", "Newcastle Jets", "Perth Glory", 
                "Sydney FC", "Wellington Phoenix", "Western Sydney Wanderers FC", "Western United FC"),
  team_color = c("#E30043", "#F26522", "#1B5E20", "#002E5C", 
                 "#7AB2E1", "#032E5E", "#024C91", "#5D2881", 
                 "#62A8DA", "#FFDD00", "#C60C30", "#2BB56C")
)

team_colors_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(nwsl_colors, usls_colors, england_colors, france_colors, australia_colors)
team_color_map <- setNames(as.list(team_colors_df$team_color), team_colors_df$team_name)

full_payload <- list(
  schedule = schedule_payload,
  shots    = shots_lookup,
  colors   = team_color_map
)

cat(sprintf(
  "\n```{=html}\n<script id=\"shot-sim-payload\" type=\"application/json\">%s</script>\n```\n",
  jsonlite::toJSON(full_payload, auto_unbox = TRUE)
))
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function() {
  const rawPayload = document.getElementById("shot-sim-payload").textContent;
  const payload = JSON.parse(rawPayload);
  let schedule = payload.schedule || [];
  let shotsMap = payload.shots || {};
  const teamColors = payload.colors || {};

  let fpInstance = null;

  const flagMap = {
    "NWSL": "\uD83C\uDDFA\uD83C\uDDF8",
    "WSL": "\uD83C\uDFF4\uDB40\uDC67\uDB40\uDC62\uDB40\uDC65\uDB40\uDC6E\uDB40\uDC67\uDB40\uDC7F",
    "Premi\u00e8re Ligue": "\uD83C\uDDEB\uD83C\uDDF7",
    "A-League Women": "\uD83C\uDDE6\uD83C\uDDFA"
  };

  window.switchSimTab = function(tab) {
    const isHist = (tab === "hist");
    document.getElementById("panel-hist").style.display = isHist ? "grid" : "none";
    document.getElementById("panel-sb").style.display = isHist ? "none" : "grid";
    document.getElementById("tab-btn-hist").classList.toggle("active", isHist);
    document.getElementById("tab-btn-sb").classList.toggle("active", !isHist);
  };

  window.downloadCanvas = function(canvasId, filename) {
    const canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
    if (!canvas) return;
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.download = filename;
    link.href = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
    link.click();
  };

  function toArray(val) {
    if (val === undefined || val === null) return [];
    return Array.isArray(val) ? val : [val];
  }

  function runVectorizedSim(homeShots, awayShots, simRuns, homeColor, awayColor) {
    const hShots = (homeShots && homeShots.length > 0) ? homeShots : [0.0001];
    const aShots = (awayShots && awayShots.length > 0) ? awayShots : [0.0001];
    const hLen = hShots.length;
    const aLen = aShots.length;

    const marginCounts = new Map();
    let homeWins = 0;
    let draws = 0;
    let awayWins = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < simRuns; i++) {
      let hGoals = 0;
      for (let j = 0; j < hLen; j++) {
        if (Math.random() < hShots[j]) hGoals++;
      }
      let aGoals = 0;
      for (let k = 0; k < aLen; k++) {
        if (Math.random() < aShots[k]) aGoals++;
      }
      const margin = hGoals - aGoals;
      if (margin > 0) homeWins++;
      else if (margin < 0) awayWins++;
      else draws++;

      marginCounts.set(margin, (marginCounts.get(margin) || 0) + 1);
    }

    const outcomes = [];
    marginCounts.forEach((count, win_margin) => {
      const pct = count / simRuns;
      let color = "#EEEDCE";
      if (win_margin >= 1) color = homeColor;
      else if (win_margin <= -1) color = awayColor;

      const perc = (pct < 0.001) ? "<0.01%" : (pct * 100).toFixed(2) + "%";
      outcomes.push({
        win_margin: win_margin,
        count: count,
        pct: pct,
        perc: perc,
        team_color: color
      });
    });

    outcomes.sort((a, b) => a.win_margin - b.win_margin);

    const pHome = homeWins / simRuns;
    const pDraw = draws / simRuns;
    const pAway = awayWins / simRuns;

    return {
      outcomes: outcomes,
      summary: {
        pHome: pHome,
        pDraw: pDraw,
        pAway: pAway,
        xPtsHome: (3 * pHome) + pDraw,
        xPtsAway: (3 * pAway) + pDraw
      }
    };
  }

  function renderSummaryStrip(stripId, summary, homeTeam, awayTeam, homeColor, awayColor) {
    const el = document.getElementById(stripId);
    if (!el || !summary) return;

    const awayPct = (summary.pAway * 100).toFixed(1) + "%";
    const drawPct = (summary.pDraw * 100).toFixed(1) + "%";
    const homePct = (summary.pHome * 100).toFixed(1) + "%";

    el.innerHTML = `
      <div class="sim-summary-outcomes">
        <span class="sim-summary-item">
          <span class="sim-swatch" style="background-color: ${awayColor};"></span>
          <span>${awayTeam} Win: <strong>${awayPct}</strong></span>
        </span>
        <span class="sim-summary-item">
          <span class="sim-swatch" style="background-color: #EEEDCE;"></span>
          <span>Draw: <strong>${drawPct}</strong></span>
        </span>
        <span class="sim-summary-item">
          <span class="sim-swatch" style="background-color: ${homeColor};"></span>
          <span>${homeTeam} Win: <strong>${homePct}</strong></span>
        </span>
      </div>
      <div class="sim-summary-xpts">
        xPts: <strong>${awayTeam} ${summary.xPtsAway.toFixed(2)}</strong> &nbsp;|&nbsp; <strong>${homeTeam} ${summary.xPtsHome.toFixed(2)}</strong>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function drawSimulationCanvas(canvasId, plotData, homeTeam, awayTeam, homeScore, awayScore, homeShots, awayShots, gameDate, venue) {
    const canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    const W = canvas.width;
    const H = canvas.height;

    ctx.fillStyle = "#000000";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    if (!plotData || plotData.length === 0) return;

    let maxMargin = 1;
    let maxPct = 0.1;
    for (let i = 0; i < plotData.length; i++) {
      const absM = Math.abs(plotData[i].win_margin);
      if (absM > maxMargin) maxMargin = absM;
      if (plotData[i].pct > maxPct) maxPct = plotData[i].pct;
    }

    const yMax = maxPct + 0.05;
    const xMin = -maxMargin - 0.5;
    const xMax = maxMargin + 0.5;

    const padLeft = 78;
    const padRight = 35;
    const padTop = 188;
    const padBottom = 114;
    const plotW = W - padLeft - padRight;
    const plotH = H - padTop - padBottom;

    // 1. Title & Two-Line Subtitle aligned with vertical Y-axis line (padLeft)
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#EEEDCE";
    ctx.font = "700 62px 'Assistant', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Simulating the Shots", padLeft, 22);

    const sumXGH = homeShots.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0).toFixed(2);
    const sumXGA = awayShots.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0).toFixed(2);
    const subLine1 = `${awayTeam} (${awayScore} Goals, ${sumXGA} xG, ${awayShots.length} Shots) at ${homeTeam} (${homeScore} Goals, ${sumXGH} xG, ${homeShots.length} Shots)`;
    const subLine2 = `${gameDate}  |  ${venue}`;

    ctx.font = "400 35px 'Assistant', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(subLine1, padLeft, 96);
    ctx.fillText(subLine2, padLeft, 138);

    // 2. Bars & Data Labels
    const unitW = plotW / (xMax - xMin);
    const barW = unitW * 0.90;

    for (let i = 0; i < plotData.length; i++) {
      const d = plotData[i];
      const centerX = padLeft + ((d.win_margin - xMin) / (xMax - xMin)) * plotW;
      const barH = (d.pct / yMax) * plotH;
      const barX = centerX - barW / 2;
      const barY = padTop + plotH - barH;

      ctx.fillStyle = d.team_color;
      ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);

      if (d.team_color.toUpperCase() === "#000000") {
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#444444";
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);
      }

      const nudgeY = (0.008 / yMax) * plotH;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#EEEDCE";
      ctx.font = "400 23px 'Assistant', sans-serif";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "bottom";
      ctx.fillText(d.perc, centerX, barY - nudgeY);
    }

    // 3. Axes Lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#EEEDCE";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(padLeft, padTop);
    ctx.lineTo(padLeft, padTop + plotH);
    ctx.lineTo(padLeft + plotW, padTop + plotH);
    ctx.stroke();

    // 4. X-Axis Ticks & Integer Labels
    ctx.fillStyle = "#EEEDCE";
    ctx.font = "400 24px 'Assistant', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    for (let m = -maxMargin; m <= maxMargin; m++) {
      const tx = padLeft + ((m - xMin) / (xMax - xMin)) * plotW;
      ctx.fillText(String(m), tx, padTop + plotH + 14);
    }

    // 5. Axis Titles
    ctx.font = "700 35px 'Assistant', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    ctx.fillText("Home Win Margin", padLeft + plotW / 2, padTop + plotH + 56);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(24, padTop + plotH / 2);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    ctx.fillText("Percentage of Simulations", 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function updateMatchListUI(league, dateStr, autoRun) {
    const container = document.getElementById("match-list-container");
    const dailyMatches = schedule.filter(m => m.competition === league && m.date === dateStr);

    if (dailyMatches.length === 0) {
      container.innerHTML = `<p style="color: #AAAAAA; margin: 0;">No matches scheduled on this date for this competition.</p>`;
      return;
    }

    let html = `<label class="sim-label">Select Match:</label><div class="sim-radio-group">`;
    dailyMatches.forEach((m, idx) => {
      const checked = (idx === 0) ? "checked" : "";
      html += `<label class="sim-radio-item"><input type="radio" name="selected_daily_match" value="${m.match_id}" onchange="runHistoricalSim()" ${checked}><span>${m.home} vs ${m.away}</span></label>`;
    });
    html += `</div><button class="sim-btn" onclick="runHistoricalSim()">Simulate Match</button>`;
    container.innerHTML = html;

    if (autoRun) {
      runHistoricalSim();
    }
  }

  window.runHistoricalSim = function() {
    const selectedRadio = document.querySelector('input[name="selected_daily_match"]:checked');
    if (!selectedRadio) return;
    const matchId = String(selectedRadio.value);
    const matchInfo = schedule.find(m => String(m.match_id) === matchId);
    if (!matchInfo) return;

    const shotEntry = shotsMap[matchId] || { venue: "League Match", h_xg: [], a_xg: [] };
    const homeShots = toArray(shotEntry.h_xg).map(Number).filter(v => !isNaN(v));
    const awayShots = toArray(shotEntry.a_xg).map(Number).filter(v => !isNaN(v));
    const venue = shotEntry.venue || "League Match";

    const homeColor = teamColors[matchInfo.home] || "#3AB5E8";
    const awayColor = teamColors[matchInfo.away] || "#EEEDCE";

    const simRes = runVectorizedSim(homeShots, awayShots, 100000, homeColor, awayColor);
    renderSummaryStrip("hist-summary-strip", simRes.summary, matchInfo.home, matchInfo.away, homeColor, awayColor);
    drawSimulationCanvas(
      "hist-canvas", simRes.outcomes,
      matchInfo.home, matchInfo.away,
      matchInfo.home_score, matchInfo.away_score,
      homeShots, awayShots,
      matchInfo.date, venue
    );
  };

  window.runSandboxSim = function() {
    const homeTeam = document.getElementById("sb-home-team").value || "Home FC";
    const awayTeam = document.getElementById("sb-away-team").value || "Away FC";
    const homeScore = Number(document.getElementById("sb-home-score").value) || 0;
    const awayScore = Number(document.getElementById("sb-away-score").value) || 0;

    const homeRaw = document.getElementById("sb-home-xg").value || "";
    const awayRaw = document.getElementById("sb-away-xg").value || "";

    const homeShots = homeRaw.split(",").map(s => parseFloat(s.trim())).filter(n => !isNaN(n) && n >= 0).map(n => Math.min(n, 0.999));
    const awayShots = awayRaw.split(",").map(s => parseFloat(s.trim())).filter(n => !isNaN(n) && n >= 0).map(n => Math.min(n, 0.999));

    const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const simRes = runVectorizedSim(homeShots, awayShots, 100000, "#F1B1A5", "#62CBC9");
    renderSummaryStrip("sb-summary-strip", simRes.summary, homeTeam, awayTeam, "#F1B1A5", "#62CBC9");
    drawSimulationCanvas(
      "sb-canvas", simRes.outcomes,
      homeTeam, awayTeam,
      homeScore, awayScore,
      homeShots, awayShots,
      todayStr, "Sandbox Arena"
    );
  };

  function onLeagueChange(autoRun) {
    const league = document.getElementById("sel-league").value;
    document.getElementById("sim-dynamic-title").textContent = `${league} Shot Simulator`;

    const leagueMatches = schedule.filter(m => m.competition === league);
    const validDates = Array.from(new Set(leagueMatches.map(m => m.date))).sort();
    const latestDate = validDates.length > 0 ? validDates[validDates.length - 1] : new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

    if (fpInstance) {
      fpInstance.destroy();
    }

    fpInstance = flatpickr("#sel-date", {
      defaultDate: latestDate,
      dateFormat: "Y-m-d",
      enable: validDates,
      onChange: function(selectedDates, dateStr) {
        updateMatchListUI(league, dateStr, true);
      }
    });

    updateMatchListUI(league, latestDate, autoRun);
  }

  function formatParquetDate(val) {
    if (val instanceof Date) {
      return val.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    }
    if (typeof val === "number") {
      return new Date(val * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    }
    return String(val).slice(0, 10);
  }

  async function syncLiveDropboxParquet() {
    try {
      const { parquetReadObjects } = await import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/hyparquet@1.8.0/+esm");
      const schedUrl = "https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/scl/fi/ibk1u01s67trk4htmhav6/master_schedule.parquet?rlkey=k943rqlck6qaomy5qovf4q98p&dl=1";
      const shotsUrl = "https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/scl/fi/78zxfgwywkge3umf86rj2/historical_shotmaps.parquet?rlkey=l8601gfmi6vgldzc8y7twgtb0&dl=1";

      const [schedRes, shotsRes] = await Promise.all([fetch(schedUrl), fetch(shotsUrl)]);
      if (!schedRes.ok || !shotsRes.ok) return;

      const [schedBuf, shotsBuf] = await Promise.all([schedRes.arrayBuffer(), shotsRes.arrayBuffer()]);
      const [liveSched, liveShots] = await Promise.all([
        parquetReadObjects({ file: schedBuf }),
        parquetReadObjects({ file: shotsBuf })
      ]);

      if (!liveSched || liveSched.length === 0) return;

      const prevCount = schedule.length;
      const newSched = liveSched.map(r => ({
        match_id: String(r.match_id),
        date: formatParquetDate(r.date),
        competition: String(r.competition),
        home: String(r.home),
        away: String(r.away),
        home_score: Number(r.home_score),
        away_score: Number(r.away_score)
      })).sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date));

      const newShotsMap = {};
      for (let i = 0; i < liveShots.length; i++) {
        const s = liveShots[i];
        const mid = String(s.match_id);
        if (!newShotsMap[mid]) {
          newShotsMap[mid] = { venue: s.venue ? String(s.venue) : "League Match", h_xg: [], a_xg: [] };
        }
        const xgVal = Math.min(Math.round(Number(s.xg) * 10000) / 10000, 0.999);
        if (!isNaN(xgVal)) {
          if (s.is_home === true || s.is_home === 1) newShotsMap[mid].h_xg.push(xgVal);
          else newShotsMap[mid].a_xg.push(xgVal);
        }
      }

      schedule = newSched;
      shotsMap = newShotsMap;

      if (newSched.length !== prevCount) {
        onLeagueChange(true);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // Retain build-time snapshot if offline or blocked
    }
  }

  function initSimulator() {
    const leagues = Array.from(new Set(schedule.map(m => m.competition))).sort();
    const selLeague = document.getElementById("sel-league");
    selLeague.innerHTML = "";

    leagues.forEach(lg => {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = lg;
      const flag = flagMap[lg] || "\uD83C\uDFF3\uFE0F";
      opt.textContent = `${flag} ${lg}`;
      if (lg === "NWSL") opt.selected = true;
      selLeague.appendChild(opt);
    });

    selLeague.addEventListener("change", () => onLeagueChange(true));

    if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) {
      document.fonts.ready.then(() => {
        onLeagueChange(true);
        runSandboxSim();
        syncLiveDropboxParquet();
      });
    } else {
      onLeagueChange(true);
      runSandboxSim();
      syncLiveDropboxParquet();
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initSimulator);
  } else {
    initSimulator();
  }
})();
</script>
```
